3600.meaning1: not wanting; not in need (of); not desiring; not seeking
3600.construction:
na > an + √atth + a + ika
anattha + ika
3600.commentary: (THa) bhaven'amhi anatthiko'ti sabbena'pi bhavena anatthiko amhi, na kiñci bhavaṃ patthemi.

examples.text: uttamaṃ dhammataṃ patto, sabbaloke anatthiko, ādittā'va gharā mutto, maraṇasmiṃ na socati.

3601.meaning1: dissatisfied (with); not interested (in); fed up (with); (comm) without expectation
3601.construction:
na > an + √atth + a + ika
anattha + ika

examples.text: ukkaṇṭhāmi sarīrena, bhaven'amhi anatthiko, so'yaṃ bhijjissati kāyo, añño ca na bhavissati.
etam'ādīnaṃ ñatvā, bhaven'amhi anatthiko, nissaṭo sabbakāmehi, patto me āsavakkhayo'ti.

3602.construction:
na > an + √atth + a + ika
anattha + ika
3602.commentary: (MNa) na ca anatthiko'ti yathā ekacco pattaṃ ādhārake ṭhapetvā patte udakaṃ na puñchati, raje patante ajjhupekkhati, na evaṃ karoti.

examples.text: so bhuttāvī na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipati n'ātidūre n'āccāsanne, na ca anatthiko pattena hoti, na ca ativel'ānurakkhī pattasmiṃ. so bhuttāvī muhuttaṃ tuṇhī nisīdati, na ca anumodanassa kālam'atināmeti.

3603.grammar: fem, abstr, from na atthika, neg (+loc)
3603.meaning1: fact of not wanting; fact of not being in need (of)
3603.construction:
na > an + √atth + a + ika + tā
anatthika + tā

examples.text: sīho'ti attānaṃ samekkhiyāna, amaññi kotthu migarāj'āham'asmi, tath'evaso siṅgālakaṃ anadi, ke ca chave siṅgāle ke pana sīhanāde'ti.

3605.meaning1: not overpowered; not overwhelmed; not dominated (by)
3605.construction: na > an + adhi > adhy > addh + ā + √bhū + ta

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti, saphalaṃ padhānaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na h'eva anaddhabhūtaṃ attānaṃ dukkhena addhabhāveti, dhammikañ'ca sukhaṃ na pariccajati, tasmiñ'ca sukhe anadhimucchito hoti.

3607.meaning1: not exceeding; not more; not in excess
3607.construction:
na > an + adhi + ka
anadhi + ka

examples.text: yadaggena tayā, āvuso channa, arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ tadaggena te brahmadaṇḍo paṭippassaddho'ti. imāya kho pana vinayasaṅgītiyā pañca bhikkhusatāni anūnāni anadhikāni ahesuṃ. tasmā ayaṃ vinayasaṅgīti pañcasatikā'ti vuccatī'ti.

3608.grammar: nt, pp of na adhigacchati, neg

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, bhiyyosomattāya vīriyaṃ ārabhatha appattassa pattiyā, anadhigatassa adhigamāya, asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilamissati. hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti. so nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.

3609.grammar: nt, abstr, from na adhigata, neg (+instr)
3609.meaning1: fact of not having attained; non-achievement (by)
3609.construction:
na > an + adhi + √gam + ta + tta
anadhigata + tta

3610.meaning2: unattained state; that which is unachieved
3610.construction:
na > an + adhi + √gam + ta + tta
anadhigata + tta

examples.text: imissā'y'eva ariyāya paññāya anadhigamā, y'āyaṃ ariyā paññā adhigatā ariyā niyyānikā, niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya.

3612.grammar: nt, act, from na adhiṭṭhāti, neg (+gen)
3612.meaning1: not taking a stand; not depending (on)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubb'ant'ānudiṭṭhīnañ'ca paṭinissaggā, apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhīnañ'ca paṭinissaggā, sabbaso kāmasaṃyojanānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānā, pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharati, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharāmī'ti. tassa sā pavivekā pīti nirujjhati.
atirekacīvaraṃ nāma anadhiṭṭhitaṃ avikappitaṃ.

3614.grammar: masc, agent, from na adhibhavati, neg, trans (+acc)
3614.meaning1: not a conqueror; who does not overcome
3614.meaning2: not a conqueror; who does not overcome

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu rūp'ādhibhūto, sadd'ādhibhūto, gandh'ādhibhūto, ras'ādhibhūto, phoṭṭhabb'ādhibhūto, dhamm'ādhibhūto, adhibhūto, anadhibhū, adhibhaṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā. evaṃ kho, āvuso, avassuto hoti.

3615.meaning1: not beset; not overcome; not overwhelmed; not overpowered (by)

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu rūp'ādhibhū, sadd'ādhibhū, gandh'ādhibhū, ras'ādhibhū, phoṭṭhabb'ādhibhū, dhamm'ādhibhū, adhibhū, anadhibhūto, adhibhosi te pāpake akusale dhamme saṃkilesike ponobbhavike sadare dukkhavipāke āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiye. evaṃ kho, āvuso, anavassuto hotī'ti.

3616.construction:
na > an + adhi + mucca + ana + tā
anadhimuccana + tā

3617.meaning1: not infatuated (with); not greedy (for); not strongly fixated (on)
3617.commentary: (MNa) anadhimucchito'ti taṇhāmucchanāya amucchito. dhammikañ'hi sukhaṃ na pariccajāmī'ti na tattha gedho kātabbo.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti, saphalaṃ padhānaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na h'eva anaddhabhūtaṃ attānaṃ dukkhena addhabhāveti, dhammikañ'ca sukhaṃ na pariccajati, tasmiñ'ca sukhe anadhimucchito hoti.

na > an + adhi + √vas > vās + *a + ka
anadhivāsa + ka

3620.meaning1: who cannot endure; unable to bear

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco akkhamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya, ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīsapa-samphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ anadhivāsakajātiko hoti.

3621.grammar: prp of na adhivāseti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
3621.meaning1: not enduring; not tolerating; not withstanding; not weathering
3621.commentary: (ANa) anadhivāsato'ti anadhivāsentassa akkhamantassa. āsav'uppatti pan'ettha evaṃ veditabbā, sītena phuṭṭhassa uṇhaṃ patthayato kām'āsavo uppajjati, evaṃ sabbattha. n'atthi sugatibhave sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā'ti bhavaṃ patthentassa bhav'āsavo, mayhaṃ sītaṃ uṇhan'ti gāho diṭṭh'āsavo, sabbeh'eva sampayutto avijj'āsavo'ti.

3622.grammar: prp of na adhivāsayati, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
3622.meaning1: not enduring; not tolerating; not weathering

examples.text: yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, anadhivāsayato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, adhivāsayato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti

3623.grammar: prp of na adhivāseti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
3623.meaning1: refusing to accept; disagreeing (with); unable to bear

examples.text: evaṃ vutto kho so brahmā taṃ vacanaṃ anadhivāsento sahassakkhattuṃ attānaṃ abhinimminitvā subrahmānaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ etadavoca, passasi me no tvaṃ, mārisa, evarūpaṃ iddh'ānubhāvan'ti? passāmi kho ty'āhaṃ, mārisa, evarūpaṃ iddh'ānubhāvan'ti.

3624.meaning1: not permeated; not pervaded; not penetrated; i.e. not defiled

examples.text: samuggatassa jhāyissa, ananugat'antarassa suddhassa, asitassa hitassa, pavivittassa aggappattassa, tiṇṇassa tārayantassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
santussako ca subharo ca, appakicco ca sallahukavutti, sant'indriyo ca nipako ca, appagabbho kulesu ananugiddho.

3627.meaningLit: not following the skin; not along the skin
3627.construction:
na > an + anu + chavi + ka
ananucchavi + ka
3627.synonym: akalla, appaṭirūpa, appatirūpa, abhadraka, asāruppa, nappatirūpa

examples.text: vigarahi buddho bhagavā, ananucchavikaṃ, moghapurisa, ananulomikaṃ appatirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
taṃ sutvā itaro saṃvegajāto, bhāriyaṃ vata me sāhasikaṃ ananucchavikaṃ kammaṃ katan'ti bāhā paggayha kandanto vanasaṇḍaṃ pakkhanditvā tathā pakkanto'va ahosi.

3628.meaning1: fact of being unfitting; unsuitability; improperness
3628.construction:
na > an + anu + chavi + ka + tta
ananucchavika + tta

3631.meaning1: not given permission; without leave; unapproved (by)
3631.commentary: (THIa) n'ānuññāto ito gato'ti idhalokato kenaci ananuññāto paralokaṃ gato.

examples.text: ayācito tat'āgacchi, ananuññāto ito gato, kutoci nūna āgantvā, vasitvā katip'āhakaṃ, ito'pi aññena gato, tato'p'aññena gacchati.
na kho'haṃ, bhante, anuññāto mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā'ti. na kho, raṭṭhapāla, tathāgatā ananuññātaṃ mātāpitūhi puttaṃ pabbājentī'ti.

3633.meaning1: not to be mourned; not to be lamented (for)

examples.text: atha no satthuno antaradhānaṃ hotī'ti. evarūpo kho, cunda, satthā sāvakānaṃ kālaṅ'kato ananutappo hoti.

3634.meaning1: not regrettable; not to be repented

examples.text: yadatthaṃ bhogaṃ iccheyya, paṇḍito gharam'āvasaṃ, so me attho anuppatto, kataṃ ananutāpiyaṃ.

3635.grammar: ger of na anupakkhandati, neg, trans (+acc)

3635.construction:

na + anupakhajja

3638.grammar: abs of na anupāpuṇāti, neg, trans (+acc)
3638.meaning1: having not reached; having not attained; having not achieved
3638.construction:
na > an + anu + pa + apuṇā + itvā
na + anupāpuṇitvā

examples.text: so evam'assa codetabbo, āyasmā kho yass'atthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, so te sāmaññ'attho ananuppatto, taṃ tvaṃ sāmaññ'atthaṃ ananupāpuṇitvā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi, idaṃ vo hitāya idaṃ vo sukhāyā'ti.

tassa taṃ vanapatthaṃ upanissāya viharato anupaṭṭhitā c'eva sati na upaṭṭhāti, asamāhitañ'ca cittaṃ na samādhiyati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā na parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañ'ca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ n'ānupāpuṇāti.

atthi nu kho… ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahit'attassa viharato avimuttañ'c'eva cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañ'ca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī'ti?

3640.grammar: prp of pass of na anu pa √dā, neg, pass, intrans
3640.meaning1: not being given; not being offered
3640.construction: na > an + anu + pa + diya + māna

examples.text: adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadiyamāne dāliddiyaṃ vepullam'agamāsi. dāliddiye vepullaṃ gate aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyi. tam'enaṃ aggahesuṃ.
catunnaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam'idaṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañ'c'eva tumhākañ'ca
avijjā'ti dukkhe aññāṇaṃ… yaṃ evarūpaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṃgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā

3642.grammar: nt, pp of na anubhavati, neg
3642.meaning1: which is not experienced; something which is not perceived; which is not apprehended

examples.text: pathaviṃ kho ahaṃ, brahme, pathavito abhiññāya yāvatā pathaviyā pathavattena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya pathaviṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviyā n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathavito n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviṃ me'ti n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviṃ n'ābhivadiṃ.

sabbaṃ kho ahaṃ, brahme, sabbato abhiññāya yāvatā sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya sabbaṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbasmiṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbato n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbaṃ me'ti n'āp'ahosiṃ, sabbaṃ n'ābhivadiṃ.

3644.meaning2: who does not give thanks; who does not give approval

3645.meaning1: not committing (to); not applying oneself (to); not engaging (with)

3646.grammar: abs of na anuyuñjati, neg, trans (+acc)
3646.meaning1: having not practised; having not engaged (in)
3646.construction:
na > an + anu + yuñja + itvā
na + anuyuñjitvā

3647.meaning1: not devoted; not applying oneself (to); not practising

examples.text: ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā… indriyesu aguttadvārā bhojane amattaññuno jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttā sāmaññe anapekkhavanto… na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

bhāvan'ānuyogaṃ ananuyuttassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno viharato kiñ'c'āpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyā'ti, atha khv'assa n'eva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati. taṃ kissa hetu?

yo kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ ananuyogo hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho, sammāpaṭipadā.

3649.meaning1: not favoured; not accepted; not pleased

examples.text: sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, ananuruddh'āppaṭiviruddhass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā, na sā niṭṭhā anuruddhappaṭiviruddhassā'ti.

3650.meaning1: who does not favour nor oppose; who does not accept nor reject

examples.text: sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, ananuruddha-appaṭiviruddhass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā, na sā niṭṭhā anuruddhappaṭiviruddhassā'ti.

3651.construction:
na > an + anu + loma + ika
ananuloma + ika

examples.text: vigarahi buddho bhagavā, ananucchavikaṃ, moghapurisa, ananulomikaṃ appatirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.

3653.meaning1: absence of the underlying tendency; lack of inherent inclination (to)
3653.meaning2: lack of inherence, lack of propensity

examples.text: tassa kāmanandī'pi n'ānuseti, byāpādanandī'pi n'ānuseti, vihesānandī'pi n'ānuseti, rūpanandī'pi n'ānuseti, sakkāyanandī'pi n'ānuseti, kāmanandiyā'pi ananusayā, byāpādanandiyā'pi ananusayā, vihesānandiyā'pi ananusayā, rūpanandiyā'pi ananusayā, sakkāyanandiyā'pi ananusayā.

3656.meaning1: not remembered; not recalled; not recollected
3656.meaning2: not recalled; not reflecting, not recollecting

examples.text: te divase divase kappasatasahassaṃ kappasatasahassaṃ anussareyyuṃ. ananussaritā'va bhikkhave, tehi kappā assu, atha kho te cattāro sāvakā vassasat'āyukā vassasatajīvino vassasatassa accayena kālaṃ kareyyuṃ. evaṃ bahukā kho, bhikkhave, kappā abbhatītā atikkantā.

3657.meaning1: unheard of; not heard (from someone else); not part of the oral tradition
3657.commentary: (SNa) pubbe ananussutesū'ti avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo hotī'ti. evaṃ ito pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu, catūsu vā ariyasaccadhammesu.

examples.text: idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan'ti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.

3660.meaning2: Chapter 4 of the Satipaṭṭhānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca puññaṃ pasavati.
imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti, no dubbhāsitā, anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnan'ti.

3663.grammar: ger of na anuvijjati, neg, intrans
3663.construction:
na > an + anu + √vid + tya
an + anuvicca

examples.text: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṃ upadaṃseti ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṃ upadaṃseti

3664.meaning1: undiscoverable; untraceable; not able to be ascertained
3664.commentary: (MNa) ananuvijjo'ti asaṃvijjamāno vā avindeyyo vā. tathāgato'ti hi satte gahite asaṃvijjamāno'ti attho vaṭṭati, khīṇ'āsave gahite avindeyyo'ti attho vaṭṭati.

examples.text: evaṃ vimuttacittaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ saindā devā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā anvesaṃ n'ādhigacchanti, idaṃ nissitaṃ tathāgatassa viññāṇan'ti. taṃ kissa hetu? diṭṭh'ev'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, dhamme tathāgataṃ ananuvijjo'ti vadāmi.

nissaṭṭhena āvuso, pañcahi indriyehi parisuddhena manoviññāṇena ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ neyyan'ti.
viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ, anantaṃ sabbatopabhaṃ, ettha āpo ca pathavī, tejo vāyo na gādhati.

3668.meaning1: with infinite good qualities; of boundless virtue

examples.text: sugandhikāyavadanaṃ, anantaguṇagandhinaṃ, sugandhin'āhaṃ gandhena, pūjayāmi tathāgataṃ.

3669.meaning1: infinite conqueror; universal victor; Ājīvaka term for an arahant

examples.text: yathā kho tvaṃ, āvuso, paṭijānāsi, arahasi anantajino'ti!

3670.meaning2: fact of being infinite; limitlessness; boundless state

3671.meaning2: fact of being infinite; limitlessness; boundless state
3671.construction:
na > an + anta + tta
ananta + tta

examples.text: evaṃ santaṃ kho, ānanda, rūpiṃ anantatt'ānudiṭṭhi anusetī'ti icc'ālaṃ vacanāya.

3672.meaning1: view of infiniteness; theory about being infinite
3672.meaning2: theory about the fact of being infinite; opinion of infiniteness

examples.text: evaṃ santaṃ kho, ānanda, rūpiṃ anantatt'ānudiṭṭhi anusetī'ti icc'ālaṃ vacanāya.

3673.meaning1: of infinite vision; having unlimited sight; with boundless insight
3673.commentary: (SNa) anantadassī bhagavā'ham'asmī'ti, bhagavā, tumhe ahaṃ anantadassī jāti-ādīni upātivatto'ti vadatha. (SNt) anantadassī'ti anantassa ñeyyassa anavasesato dassī.

examples.text: anantadassī bhagavā'ham'asmi, jātijaraṃ sokam'upātivatto, kiṃ me purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, ācikkha me taṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññā'ti.

3674.meaning2: of infinite understanding, of endless wisdom

examples.text: adhikāre maṅgale c'eva, nipphanne c'āvadhāraṇe, anantare c'apādāne, athasaddo pavattati.
anantare sare pare sarā lopaṃ papponti.
hetupaccayo, ārammaṇapaccayo, adhipatipaccayo, anantarapaccayo, samanantarapaccayo, sahajātapaccayo, aññam'aññapaccayo

3678.meaning1: no secret teaching; no inner doctrine
3678.commentary: (SNa) anantaraṃ abāhiran'ti dhammavasena vā puggalavasena vā ubhayaṃ akatvā. ettakaṃ dhammaṃ parassa na desessāmī'ti hi cintento dhammaṃ abbhantaraṃ karoti nāma, ettakaṃ parassa desessāmī'ti cintento bāhiraṃ karoti nāma. imassa puggalassa desessāmī'ti cintento pana puggalaṃ abbhantaraṃ karoti nāma, imassa na desessāmī'ti cintento puggalaṃ bāhiraṃ karoti nāma. evaṃ akatvā desito'ti attho.

examples.text: desito, ānanda, mayā dhammo anantaraṃ abāhiraṃ karitvā. natthānanda, tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhi.

3679.grammar: nt, abstr, from na antara, neg
3679.meaning1: fact of immediately following; immediacy; instantaneousness
3679.construction:
na > an + anta + ra + tta
anantara + tta

3680.grammar: nt, act, comp, from na antaradhāyati, neg
3680.meaning1: non-disappearance; not fading away; not vanishing

examples.text: ime kho, kassapa, pañca dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattantī'ti.
yaṃ sa [yaṃ tassa anantarasutte pana yaṃ sa itv'eva sabbattha'pi dissati] hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.
[iti duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretabbaṃ, duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretvā anantaravārattaye pana idaṃ pāṭhanānattaṃ n'atthi]

3684.grammar: pp of na antaradhāyati, comp, neg

examples.text: so anantarahitāya bhūmiyā harit'upalittāya seyyaṃ kappeti.

3685.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of na antara, neg
3685.meaning2: immediately after that; with no interval
3685.construction:
na > an + anta + ra + aṃ
anantara + aṃ

examples.text: atha ca pana bhavaṃ ānando evam'āha, atthi c'ev'ettha uttarikaraṇīyan'ti [imassa anantaraṃ sī. pī. potthakesu paṭhamabhāṇavāraṃ'ti pāṭho dissati].

3686.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of anantara, neg (+abl)
3686.meaning1: immediately afterwards; directly following; contiguously; next
3686.construction:
na > an + anta + ra + ā
anantara + ā

examples.text: sekhassa sikkhamānassa, ujumagg'ānusārino, khayasmiṃ paṭhamaṃ ñāṇaṃ, tato aññā anantarā.
animittañ'ca bhāvemi, ek'aggā susamāhitā, anantarāvimokkh'āsiṃ, anupādāya nibbutā.

3687.grammar: adj, comp, from na antarāya, neg
3687.meaning1: having no obstacle; without obstruction; with no hindrance
3687.meaning2: not subject to hindrance or danger; not forming an impediment
3687.construction:
na > an + antara + aya + ika
antarāya + ika

3688.grammar: adj, comp, from na antarāyika, neg
3688.meaning1: having no obstacle; without obstruction; with no hindrance
3688.construction:
na > an + antara + aya + ika + ī
antarāya + ika + ī

3689.meaning2: with no space intervening; immediately preceding or following

3690.meaning1: perceiving as infinite; regarding as unlimited

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte anantasaññī lokasmiṃ viharati.

3691.construction:
na > an + anta + vant
ananta + vant

examples.text: kiṃ pana, bhante, anantavā loko, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti? etam'pi kho, poṭṭhapāda, mayā abyākataṃ, anantavā loko, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti.

3694.meaning1: without internal defilements; without impurities inside
3694.meaning2: without resident pupils; i.e. without internal impurities

examples.text: santevāsiko, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sācariyako dukkhaṃ na phāsu viharati. anantevāsiko, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anācariyako sukhaṃ phāsu viharati. kathañ'ca, bhikkhu, santevāsiko sācariyako dukkhaṃ na phāsu viharati?

3695.meaning1: not living together; not dwelling near

3696.meaning1: free from pleasure; not enjoying; without delight

examples.text: aghajātassa ve nandī, nandījātassa ve aghaṃ, anandī anagho bhikkhu, evaṃ jānāhi āvuso'ti.
cirassaṃ vata passāmi, brāhmaṇaṃ parinibbutaṃ, anandiṃ anaghaṃ bhikkhuṃ, tiṇṇaṃ loke visattikan'ti.

3697.meaning1: not blind; who can see; not spiritually ignorant

examples.text: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ bhoto gotamassa! pahoti me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yath'āhaṃ imamhā āsanā anandho vuṭṭhaheyyan'ti.
